state.paragraph: G&W was $1.00 more per share; (2) the termination fee payable by the Company in the event the Board exercised its "fiduciary out" in order to accept a superior proposal was less under the G&W draft agreement than the Party B draft agreement; and (3) the STB approval process for G&W and Party B would be different since G&W owned connecting railroads. The Board arranged a telephone call with the Company's STB counsel to discuss the process for obtaining the required regulatory approval or exemption for the transaction, the risks associated with each process, the use of a voting trust to enable an earlier closing of the transaction (as contemplated by the G&W merger agreement) and the likely timeframe for obtaining any regulatory clearance for a transaction with either Party B or G&W. Based upon that discussion, the Board determined that the timeframe for, and the likelihood of, obtaining the required regulatory approval was not materially different for a transaction with G&W versus a transaction with Party B. At the request of the Board, representatives of BMO then contacted Party B to determine if it would increase its offer price. Party B indicated that it would not increase its price.

ledger_rows.Note: Preferred Party B: continue both finalists but prioritize Party B and complete its merger-agreement negotiation because of its higher price.
The 08/04 direction named only G&W and Party B for continuing diligence and negotiations, omitting re-entered Party E.
Changed G&W’s information: BMO told it the Company intended to sign with another bidder; G&W was allowed to finish diligence.
G&W legal counsel; first seen acting in discussions of the merger and voting agreements.
Cash LOI after physical diligence, with merger/voting markups; CVR removed; only final documentation reported; offer expired 08/13 at 6 p.m.
At the Board’s request BMO sought an increase; Party B refused, and the Board selected G&W’s $25 offer as superior.

ledger_rows.Who: Providence and Worcester Railroad Company and G&W
ledger_rows.Note: G&W agreed to acquire the Company for $25.00 per common share in cash; preferred stock deemed converted 100-for-1.
Company publicly announced the signed transaction before NASDAQ trading opened.

bid.instructions: `paragraph` reports that a bidder submits, revises, confirms or reaffirms a priced proposal, indication of interest or offer for the company. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.
